rubric.role_summary: Senior B2B partner marketing role building a partnerships marketing function, leading joint go-to-market campaigns and launches, and measuring partner-generated pipeline.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Senior B2B partner marketing role building a partnerships marketing function, leading joint go-to-market campaigns and launches, and measuring partner-generated pipeline.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- 5+ years in B2B marketing.
- Experience running joint go-to-market with technology or ISV partners, cloud providers, or system integrators.
- Hands-on full-funnel campaign marketing experience.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Experience in partner, alliance, or ecosystem marketing.
- Proven experience running joint go-to-market with technology and ISV partners, cloud providers, or system integrators, and shipping campaigns that generated pipeline.
- Hands-on full-funnel campaign experience across webinars, events, ABM, content, and digital.
- Experience setting up attribution and reporting partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline, using CRM and revenue operations tools.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Accept any one of these geographic alternatives (OR): San Francisco Bay Area, California; New York metropolitan area. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them. Hybrid work is based in one of these areas.
